description: Served with the Multinational Force and Observers at El Gorah, Sinai, with ARDU and then Army 171 Squadron, 1st Aviation Regiment. The last No. 5 Squadron D/H model to be camouflaged. Delivered to the museum 8 September 2014 and placed on display (ADF-Serials).

First flight 13/08/1969. Flew with the Central Flying School as part of the Roulettes in 1970, 1981 and 1986 and with No. 76 Squadron. Held at Northam when the surviving Macchis were disposed of in 2004 and acquired by the museum, which reported it incomplete and needing many parts before static display (ADF-Serials).
aliases: MB326; MB326H; Macchi; CA-30; CA30; c/n CA30-57

description: Allocated to RAAF Pearce for promotional purposes and stored or displayed in the open there from 2003 to 2018, latterly in a dark grey scheme with yellow arrows and a black skull on the fin. Donated to the museum and moved there in May 2018, awaiting restoration and reassembly; a left wing has gone to another restoration (ADF-Serials).
